title: Missing Middle Housing — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Missing-middle types, such as duplexes, fourplexes, courtyard apartments, and townhouses, fit between detached homes and mid-rise apartments. They add density at a scale compatible with single-family streets. This overview edition presents Missing Middle Housing as a core housing concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Add supply at many price points
Locate homes near jobs and transit
